info.title: warte agent API
info.description: Machine-readable answers for agents, from the ground station's latest snapshot. Read-only. The ground station's own API (ETA, state, history, reports) is under /ci; see /ci/api/openapi.json.

get.summary: Fleet queue: self-hosted runners, hosted pool, and optionally one repo

parameters.name: repo
parameters.description: Repository name without the org, e.g. spar

400.description: repo is not a bare repository name

503.description: no ground station configured, or no snapshot received yet

get.summary: Should an agent open a PR of this kind in this repo now?
get.description: security and red-main are always open. docs batch whenever the repo has CI in flight. fix and feature use thresholds kept in warte. Stale data (snapshot older than 5 minutes) never gates: the verdict is open and the reason says so.

400.description: missing or invalid repo or kind

503.description: no ground station configured, or no snapshot received yet

get.summary: Long-poll: hold until a PR's or branch's CI runs start or finish
get.description: Answers at once when the CI state differs from the cursor in since; otherwise holds until a snapshot changes it or timeout passes (changed: false). Without since, the state at the call is the baseline. Pass the returned cursor as since on the next call so no change is missed. Resolution is one snapshot (about a minute). At most 8 held requests per client and 1024 in total. The CLI is warte watch --ci.

parameters.name: pr
parameters.description: PR number; give exactly one of pr or branch

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Seconds to hold, default 300, at most 900

200.description: Changed, or held until the timeout

400.description: missing or invalid repo, pr/branch, since or timeout

503.description: no ground station, no snapshot yet, or too many watchers

get.summary: Every machine the ground station hears from, with drift findings
get.description: Latest probe report per machine (OS, kernel, CPU, memory, disks, agent CLIs and their versions, agent sessions without command lines), its age and a stale flag (no report for 3 minutes), plus findings: kernel or tool versions behind the newest seen, full disks, low memory, overload, silence.

queued_complete.description: False: the queue scan was incomplete, so a missing run may still be queued

recheck_s.description: Seconds until asking again is worthwhile; absent for open
